name: Cornell University Berry Breeding Program
description: Public breeding program at Cornell University releasing both raspberry and strawberry cultivars. Released raspberries Double Gold and Crimson Night (2012, aimed at small-scale growers and home gardeners, vigorous and disease resistant) and, in 2019, the raspberry Crimson Treasure alongside the strawberry Dickens -- both described as producing large, vibrantly colored fruit with flavor that holds longer than most heritage varieties.
